Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Channel brokerage & listing roadmap: Nimbus x Redwood

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier this week. As discussed, Nimbus is interested in listing Redwood across AWS, Azure and GCP marketplaces and exploring co-sell/referral motion with your channel brokerage team. To keep momentum I sketched a short mutual action plan and wanted to confirm owners and a realistic timeline.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which marketplaces you operate as a broker vs. direct listing (AWS private offers vs. Azure co-sell registration vs. GCP listing ops)?
- Any required SOW or reseller agreement template you want us to complete up front?
- Are there preferred SKU/entitlement patterns you need for marketplace billing?

Attaching a lightweight checklist (redwood_nimbus_listing_checklist_v1.xlsx) — it calls out owners on our side. Proposed internal owners: Jonas (marketplace ops/technical evidence), Vanessa (commercial & pricing), Sergio (legal/compliance).

Target outcome: agreed mutual action plan + milestone dates so we can commit engineering and bizdev resources.

Would next Wed (Nov 18) at 11am PT work for a 30min sync to finalize?

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_nimbus_listing_checklist_v1.xlsx
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbuspartners.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel brokerage & listing roadmap: Nimbus x Redwood

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the checklist — looks like a good starting point. A few clarifying notes from Marketplace Ops:

1) Coverage: We can broker private offers on AWS and support co-sell desk introductions for Azure (we do not operate the Azure Co-Sell Seller Partner Program directly, but we have established ISV pathways with a partner manager). For GCP we usually do a direct listing engagement (we coordinate engineering work + evidence).

2) Evidence & controls: For AWS/Azure/GCP we will need SOC2 summary, a security questionnaire (we'll send our template), and an operations contact for entitlements/billing testing.

3) Commercials: We typically ask for a reseller discount matrix and a 90-day trial pricing band to bootstrap co-sell deals.

I'll loop in our marketplace engineer (cc'd to mp-ops) with a short intake form. If you can fill out the SOW template we use, that would speed things up — I'll attach it in a follow-up.

Wed 11am PT works; confirm and we'll send calendar invite.

Best,
Ellen Park
Director, Partnerships — Nimbus Partners
ellen.park@nimbuspartners.com

Team — forwarding Nimbus' reply (below). Key points for ops/legal/pricing:

- Nimbus can broker AWS private offers, help with Azure co-sell intros, and coordinate a direct GCP listing engagement.
- They need SOC2 summary, security questionnaire, and an ops contact for entitlement testing.
- They asked for a reseller discount matrix and a 90-day trial band.

Action items I want from each of you before Wed sync (Nov 18, 11am PT):
- Jonas: confirm what technical evidence we can produce quickly (SOC2 summary, deployment topology doc, and access pattern statements) and estimate effort for marketplace entitlements testing.
- Vanessa: draft a reseller discount matrix + 90-day trial pricing proposal; include recommended MSRP and suggested commission splits for brokered deals.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Channel brokerage & listing roadmap: Nimbus x Redwood

Naomi / team —

Quick ops notes after scanning the checklist:
- SOC2: we can produce an SOC2 Type II summary report and an exported controls matrix by EOD Fri (Nov 20).
- Security questionnaire: ask Nimbus to send their template; we can return a completed draft in ~5 business days.
- Entitlement testing: requires a small QA cycle (provisioning + billing validation) — estimate 3 engineers @ 3 days (can be staggered).
- SKU/entitlement model suggestion: 1 core SKU (redwood-inference-base) + optional add-on SKUs for dedicated capacity and private deployment licensing — this maps cleanly to marketplace SKUs for AWS/GCP; Azure prefers meter-based offers but supports SKU bundles.

Timeline suggestion (tentative):
- Week 1: intake + evidence exchange (SOC2, questionnaire)
- Week 2–3: billing/entitlement test and SKU mapping
- Week 4–6: listing submission & first validation window (marketplace review cycles differ by cloud)

I'll drop a link to our internal docs and the HubSpot ticket where we should track milestones: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/10294

–Jonas
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@nimbuspartners.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel brokerage & listing roadmap: Nimbus x Redwood

Ellen / team —

Thanks for the clarity. A few commercial items from my side:

1) Reseller discount matrix (attached): bulk tiers at 10/20/30% with a proposed broker commission of 12% for Nimbus on private-offer-led deals.
2) Trial construct: we can offer a 90-day trial coupon (non-billable SKU) for net-new customers from the brokerage program; terms to be captured in the SOW.
3) SKU notes: agree with Jonas' mapping. Need Marketplace Ops engineers' contact for billing tests — cc'ing our AM for coordination in the invite.

If Nimbus requires pricing confidentiality, we can append a short NDA addendum to the SOW. Happy to discuss a limited-time promotional rebate if they can commit to an initial pipeline target (we can bake that into a joint MQA).

Next steps: Naomi to send calendar invite for Wed 11am PT (or alternate) with the intake form and our SOW draft.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
